pub fn longest_common_substring(s1: &str, s2: &str) -> String {
    if s1.is_empty() || s2.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    
    let s1_chars: Vec<char> = s1.chars().collect();
    let s2_chars: Vec<char> = s2.chars().collect();
    let (m, n) = (s1_chars.len(), s2_chars.len());
    
    let mut dp = vec![vec![0; n + 1]; m + 1];
    let mut max_len = 0;
    let mut end_pos = 0;
    
    for i in 1..=m {
        for j in 1..=n {
            if s1_chars[i-1] == s2_chars[j-1] {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1;
                if dp[i][j] > max_len {
                    max_len = dp[i][j];
                    end_pos = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    s1_chars[end_pos - max_len..end_pos].iter().collect()
}

bool isValidParentheses(const string& s) {
    stack<char> st;

        if (c == '(' || c == '{' || c == '[') {
            st.push(c);
        } else if (c == ')' || c == '}' || c == ']') {
            if (st.empty()) return false;
            char top = st.top();

            if ((c == ')' && top != '(') ||

class URLShortener:
    def __init__(self, storage_file='urls.json'):
        self.storage_file = storage_file
        self.mappings = self._load_mappings()
    
    def _load_mappings(self):

            with open(self.storage_file, 'r') as f:

def min_matrix_chain_cost(dimensions):
    n = len(dimensions)
    if n < 2:
        return 0
    
    # dp[i][j] = minimum cost to multiply matrices i to j
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # l is chain length
    for l in range(2, n):
        for i in range(1, n - l + 1):
            j = i + l - 1
            dp[i][j] = float('inf')
            for k in range(i, j):
                cost = dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] + dimensions[i-1] * dimensions[k] * dimensions[j]
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], cost)
    
    return dp[1][n-1]

pub fn kth_smallest(arr: &[i32], k: usize) -> Option<i32> {
    if k == 0 || k > arr.len() {
        return None;
    }
    
    let mut working = arr.to_vec();
    Some(quickselect(&mut working, 0, working.len() - 1, k - 1))
}

fn quickselect(arr: &mut [i32], left: usize, right: usize, k: usize) -> i32 {
    if left == right {
        return arr[left];
    }
    
    let pivot_index = partition(arr, left, right);
    
    if k == pivot_index {
        arr[k]
    } else if k < pivot_index {
        quickselect(arr, left, pivot_index - 1, k)
    } else {
        quickselect(arr, pivot_index + 1, right, k)
    }
}

fn partition(arr: &mut [i32], left: usize, right: usize) -> usize {
    let pivot = arr[right];
    let mut i = left;
    
    for j in left..right {
        if arr[j] <= pivot {
            arr.swap(i, j);
            i += 1;
        }
    }
    arr.swap(i, right);
    i
}

```python

def levenshtein_distance(s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
    m, n = len(s1), len(s2)
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    
    for i in range(m + 1):
        dp[i][0] = i
    for j in range(n + 1):
        dp[0][j] = j
    
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            if s1[i-1] == s2[j-1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])
    
    return dp[m][n]
EOF
```

def longest_palindrome(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return ""
    
    def expand_around_center(left, right):
        while left >= 0 and right < len(s) and s[left] == s[right]:
            left -= 1
            right += 1
        return s[left + 1:right]
    
    longest = ""
    for i in range(len(s)):
        # Odd length palindromes
        palindrome1 = expand_around_center(i, i)
        # Even length palindromes
        palindrome2 = expand_around_center(i, i + 1)
        
        for p in [palindrome1, palindrome2]:
            if len(p) > len(longest):
                longest = p
    
    return longest

def validate_iban(iban: str) -> bool:
    # Remove spaces and convert to uppercase
    iban = iban.replace(' ', '').upper()
    
    # Basic length check (IBANs are typically 15-34 characters)
    if len(iban) < 15 or len(iban) > 34:
        return False
    
    # Check that first two characters are letters (country code)
    if not iban[:2].isalpha():
        return False
    
    # Move first 4 characters to the end
    rearranged = iban[4:] + iban[:4]
    
    # Replace letters with numbers (A=10, B=11, ..., Z=35)
    numeric_string = ''
    for char in rearranged:
        if char.isalpha():
            numeric_string += str(ord(char) - ord('A') + 10)
        else:
            numeric_string += char
    
    # Check mod 97
    try:
        return int(numeric_string) % 97 == 1
    except ValueError:
        return False

def levenshtein_distance(s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
    m, n = len(s1), len(s2)
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    
    for i in range(m + 1):
        dp[i][0] = i
    for j in range(n + 1):
        dp[0][j] = j
    
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            if s1[i-1] == s2[j-1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])
    
    return dp[m][n]
EOF

def day_of_week(year, month, day):
    # Zeller's congruence treats Jan and Feb as months 13 and 14 of the previous year
    if month < 3:

        year -= 1
    
    q = day
